title: The updated version lowered functionality
body:
The update lowered functionality. 
- the clocks were set back to their original time during the update. 
- the clocks are now arranged the other way around 
- you can’t undo what you are doing when changing time (you could do it in the previous version)
- when setting the time, the clock rollers (hours, minutes, and seconds) stopped at zero, now not anymore. 
- added clocks are put on the top. Why?

And no additional interesting feature. 
- it would be nice if we could change the order of the clocks.

title: Simplicity lost in translation
body: The beauty of the Time Timer lies in its simplicity: it visualizes remaining time clearly without hassle. This app does too many things: restarting and managing timers with many settings. Why? It confuses me and makes it hard to use in situations where I want a timer that gets out of my way – the app requires my attention when I want to spend it elsewhere.
